name: Frances Rosetta Allen (Charters)
notable_stories: A bright Marceline girl who won signal honors in high school
Her academic work was chosen to be displayed at the Jamestown Exposition

A Marceline Herald item ('Bright Marceline Girl') reported that at Central High School in St. Louis she passed most grades without examination and was one of six students chosen to have their work exhibited at the Jamestown exposition.
milestones: Married John Dixon Charters (m. 12 Sep 1918, Ashton, Lee County, IL)
education: Attended the Marceline public schools and later Central High School in St. Louis
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
